answer: By the voyage of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, published publicly on failure. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the garden of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
